source_event_fidelity: Frozen source MIDI hashes and source note-on/off pairs were verified across all 12 inputs. For drum triggers, each source channel-9 trigger record includes source_channel and source_end_tick and is pair-matched against the source MIDI. This verifies source provenance, not event identity of the renderer-only FluidSynth derivative.
drum_adapter_policy: The FluidSynth render-only derivative omits source drum note-offs so selected one-shot samples follow their natural sample decay; this does not assert source note-offs are artificial or invalid. Closed/pedal-hat events choke an active open-hat sample. Temporary channel, pitch, and control-flow adaptations are not original MIDI events. Frozen source MIDI is unchanged.
event_fidelity_check_scope: 42,063 note-on/off source pairs verified against frozen MIDI and mapped trigger provenance. Pitched stems retain source pitch/onset/offset/velocity events; drum trigger logs preserve source onsets and are paired to source off ticks, while the renderer-only drum derivative applies the documented one-shot/choke policy and is not byte-for-byte/event-for-event identical.
loudness_policy: A/B/C preview static gain; comparison target follows existing A/B target within ±0.3 LU; C game OGG uses separately reported fixed attenuation to approximately -21 LUFS and TP <= -3 dBTP
effects_policy: Tone shaping is applied in source role stems. Gentle bus compression was used for The Nobodies, Man That You Fear, Deformography, Minute of Decay. No time, pitch, MIDI event, or CC edits were made.
